description: Test suite for AVC parameter set conversions and validation functions in the 'avc_util' module, including tests for Annex B and AVCC formats, parameter set validity, and conversion correctness.

classes.name: AvcParameterSets
classes.description: Class representing AVC parameter sets, supporting validation, format conversion, and parameter set extraction.

methods.name: ConvertAnnexBToAvcc
methods.description: Converts a vector of Annex B formatted NALUs to AVCC format.

methods.name: is_valid
methods.description: Checks if the parameter sets are valid.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Returns the format of the parameter sets (Annex B or Headless).

methods.name: has_sps_and_pps
methods.description: Indicates if the parameter sets contain SPS and PPS.

methods.name: GetAddresses
methods.description: Returns the addresses of individual NALUs.

methods.name: GetSizesInBytes
methods.description: Returns the sizes of individual NALUs.

methods.name: combined_size_in_bytes
methods.description: Returns the total size of all NALUs combined.

methods.name: ConvertTo
methods.description: Converts parameter sets to a different format (e.g., Headless).
